raw_text: “The wandering mendicant Śreṇika became a believer in this discourse, and, having become a believer, entered into the knowledge of the All-Aspect Omniscient One as a follower on account of faith, taking reality as his standard since he did not apprehend anything at all. Having thus become a resolute believer, he did not grasp anything at all because he was without mental images and was not attentive to anything. Because all phenomena cannot be grasped and cannot be relinquished, he did not apprehend anything that he might have grasped or anything that he might have relinquished. Since he did not give rise to conceit about any phenomena, he did not give rise to conceit even about nirvāṇa.
